verdict.rationale: Kit's pricing page lists "A/B test subject lines & content" and "A/B test subject lines" as features, so it has a first-party A/B testing capability covering both subject lines and content. The evidence is only one-line pricing bullets, and nothing shows the winner being picked automatically from engagement. Per-broadcast open/click stats are adjacent reporting and do not count as winner selection. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic winner selection based on opens/clicks, any detail on how tests are configured (split size, test duration), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
